scope: Qualify complete release-browser correctness, process-memory non-regression and descriptive timing for the combined implicit metadata representation. The independently demonstrated claim is avoided typed-array backing; no elapsed or whole-process gain is assumed.
controls: Four interleaved identical-source A/C pairs per host
timingBoundary: File input change through post-UI completion; fresh profiles, no profiling/memory/screenshot instrumentation
memory: Separate existing covered ABBA/BAAB acquisition after timing; every observation must qualify, median PSS/private<=+5%, each pair<=+10%
persistence: Current native restart,72 lookup receipts,deterministic media samples per timed import; separate exhaustive media; unchanged exact non-SAH sizes; VNDB37 aligned4096-byte allocation units
package: Local complete inventory already verified against frozen runtime; exactly3JS+canonicalC+canonicalWASM entries differ,ZIP+2398B,WASM+458B. Hosted ZIP hashes/sizes remain independently recorded.
failurePolicy: Retain all observations/tails/failures; no replacement run of an unchanged candidate to recover an adverse or incomplete result.
promotion: A successful correctness/memory acquisition is not a speed claim. Publish only the demonstrated allocation reduction unless timing benefits independently replicate beyond identical-control variability.
